title: Das Kloster-Tagebuch des Einsiedler Paters Joseph Dietrich, 1670-1704 – Kommentierte Online-Edition
author: Joseph Dietrich
institution: Abteilung für Wirtschafts-, Sozial- und Umweltgeschichte, Historisches Institut, Universität Bern
notes: The diary has 18 volumes and about 12,000 pages; a diplomatic transcription with footnotes, Latin translations, weather observations and registers is published volume by volume. Four volumes are online so far: Band 6 (1687-1688), Band 13 (1688-1690), Band 15 (1693-1694) and Band 17 (1697-1698); all are within the period. The others are transcribed but not yet published. Band 17 and a new full-text search were added on 9 October 2026. The counts cover the four published volumes of 18, each counted as one text. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
